name: SIMPAR S.A.
summary: SIMPAR S.A., an investment holding company, provides light vehicle rental, and fleet management and outsourcing services in Brazil. The company provides logistics services, road transportation of cargo and commodities, internal logistics, urban distribution, storage, and passenger charter; lease of light vehicles, and management and outsourcing of light vehicles fleets to the private and public sectors with drivers, municipal passenger transport and urban cleaning; and rental, fleet management and provision of mechanical maintenance, bodywork, industrialization, and customization services.
